authorization.request: 安排有价值、有目的、基于Phase2.4问题的新实验；GPU0/1，时间一天两天或更久

historical_reuse.condition: input/code/stream/initialization/optimizer/precision/evaluation binding equivalent; otherwise historical anchor only
historical_reuse.on_mismatch: historical nonpaired reference only; no automatic rerun; R1/R2 eight endpoints remain primary

common.units: verify raw DSM unit before metric interpretation
common.scope: relative tile-centered height; not nDSM or absolute elevation

adaptation.A1: A0+patch_embedding_projection_weight_bias; early8 weights frozen, gradient path retained

primary_contrast: M21-M11, each seed and tile; seed-pooled first and individual tiles preserved

conditional_counter.change: Fit tile robust span derangement: g_t=s_pi(t)/s_t, train only; normal R2 evaluation
conditional_counter.no_practical_disruption_description: both seed pooled abs(C21-M21)<=0.2 pp; descriptive, not statistical equivalence

downstream.rgb_faults: old zero/down4 x 4 families x 20 masks x 2 tiles
downstream.dsm_faults: new raw-height down4 and shift(+8,0) native pixels; normalize observed input
downstream.primary_benefit_comparison: M21-M11 for each DSM seed on RGB-down4

timing.planning_window: one to two days or longer; throughput not yet measured

reporting.evidence_level: reused development tiles, two DSM seeds, one fixed RGB seed

spatial_scale_diagnostic.fixed_R2_denominator: original training Fit12 S at every sampling version
